Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the note and for proposing a time. We definitely want the demo, but one heads-up from procurement: we require an executed NDA and completion of our vendor onboarding questionnaire before we allow external demos that include product/architecture deep-dives. That's a standard gate for any vendor pilot here.

I've copied Tom from Procurement — he'll own the questionnaire. I'll need the NDA (preferably via DocuSign) and the completed questionnaire returned before we can lock a demo time. If it's quicker for your team, we can do a short discovery call with procurement (10-15 minutes) to clarify any questions rather than going back and forth on email.

If we don't have the paperwork by tomorrow, please feel free to reschedule the demo — we can pick new times next week after the vendor checks are complete.

Thanks,
